site.name: My Writings
site.tagline: Poems, blogs and quotes — in Gujarati, Hindi and English
site.about:
Write a few lines about yourself here — where you write from, what you write about, and anything a reader should know before they begin.

Settings → Site → About you.

entries.title: Start here
entries.body:
This site is yours. Nothing here is fixed — every part of it is meant to be changed, and this page is here only until you replace it.

Getting in
Scroll to the bottom of any page and tap the small lock. The first time, you choose an admin passphrase; after that it unlocks the editing tools on this device. Once you are in, a + button appears in the corner and a gear appears in the header.

Writing something
Tap + and write. Choose whether it is a poem, a blog or a quote, and which language it is in — Gujarati, Hindi or English. Your line breaks are kept exactly as you type them, which matters for poetry.

The Style tab beside it restyles that one piece on its own: a different typeface, larger or smaller text, looser lines, a colour, a gradient or a photograph behind it. The preview at the top updates as you go.

Making it look like yours
The gear opens Settings. Site is your name, photo and links. Home page controls the layout, how many pieces appear before the See more button, which tabs exist, and what the header says. Theme has eight palettes, light and dark, custom accent colours, page backgrounds and a font for each of the three scripts.

Sharing a piece
Open anything and press Share. You can save it as a picture sized for Instagram, a story or a post; save it as a PDF; copy it as plain text; download a .txt; or copy a link straight to that one piece. The picture is drawn with your own fonts and colours, signed with your name.

Publishing
Everything you change is saved on this device first, and the site stays exactly as it was for everyone else until you press Publish. Settings has a Publish tab: paste a GitHub token once, and from then on Publish pushes your work live in about a minute.

Deleting this page
Open it, press Edit, then the delete button. It will not come back.
entries.excerpt: How to write, restyle, share and publish on this site — and how to delete this page once you no longer need it.

entries.title: ચોમાસું
entries.body:
છાપરા પર ટપ ટપ,
અને મનમાં પણ
એવું જ કંઈક.

ભીના થયા વિના
કોઈ ચોમાસું
પૂરું થતું નથી.

entries.title: शब्द
entries.body:
जो कहा नहीं गया
वह भी लिखा गया है —

हर ख़ाली जगह में,
हर रुकी हुई साँस में।
જે લખાય છે તે ક્યારેય એકલું નથી હોતું.

लिखना, ख़ुद से बात करने का
सबसे धीमा तरीक़ा है।

A page is patient.
It waits as long as you need.
